title: Piers Park Sailing Center
specs: Inclusive and accessible sailing programs with ADA-accessible facilities
Over 3,000 children participate annually in youth programs
Located on the East Boston waterfront with views of Boston Harbor and skyline
Guests must be at least 4 years old to sail or kayak
Participants in Learn to Sail must be adults over 21 years old
Swim certification required for youth programs; must swim 50 yards and tread water 5 minutes for adults
All participants must sign guest release form; minors require guardian signature
Passholders must have valid sail or kayak pass to use boats
Groups from 2 to 42 participants; larger groups split across multiple boats
Group sailing boats hold 4-6 people plus a qualified skipper
includes: Life jackets and all sailing equipment provided
Qualified skipper on board for group sailing
gap: Exact duration and schedule details for group sailing sessions not stated
blurb: Piers Park Sailing Center offers sailing and kayaking experiences, youth programs, and group sailing activities. They provide sailing lessons for beginners and opportunities for independent sailing with a valid pass. The center emphasizes safety, inclusivity, and environmental stewardship.
extraNote: Boats available by online reservation only · Boats must return 30 minutes before sunset or incur $50 late fee per 15 minutes · No alcohol or drugs allowed on boats or premises; violation results in termination of privileges · Smoking and vaping prohibited on dock, boats, and office · Cancellation and fee adjustments possible due to weather or operational disruptions · Damage fees up to $500 deductible plus full cost for uninsured damage; towing fees $100-$500 depending on boundary · Piers Park dock, East Boston waterfront · May 1st to October 31st regular season; November 1st to April 30th hardy season

quotes.text: I am forever grateful of the great opportunity Piers Park Sailing has provided my children for the past several years as Harbor Explorers. Their commitment to teach children all aspects of sailing is remarkable. The staff goes above and beyond their call of duty. All staff members are genuinely friendly and caring. Thank you for providing my children with another wonderful year of learning.

Our kid loves the programs at Piers Park. Camp was so much fun and so educational and so well run that our kid signed up for the fall programs and wants to go back next summer. Piers Park Sailing Center is a beautiful culture. The kids that work here are empowered. The directors are graduates and are very caring. Great strategic vision. We are very lucky to have found this place.

As a quadriplegic, I am obviously limited in the sports that I can now participate in. Being an athlete prior to being injured in 87', I have always looked for activities that would make me feel like I was being physically active again. Thanks for introducing me to this great sport! I also can't say enough about the whole staff at Piers Park.

My son, is a young man with complex special needs. Your instructor is doing a tremendous job with him. He intuitively understood how to deal with his physical limitations and his unique way of communicating. He treats him with respect and kindness. Most importantly he treats him like just another kid. We, as parents, could not ask for more.

This summer was truly special for my kids (11 and 6) at Piers Park. They loved every moment and learned so much in such a short amount of time. I've never seen them so enthusiastic about an activity before. I'm so grateful that opportunities like this exist for kids in East Boston.

Great experience with kayaking with friends. The staff were very patient with me. I don't know how to swim and was scared but was able to learn to kayak on my own. Shout out to Nick who helped me become more confident with the water and kayaking. Beautiful view of the city.
